name: wrong-path
description: The URL points somewhere that is not the Slurp'it portal (or omits a reverse-proxy prefix), so /api/platform/ping answers 404. The preflight must end the run with the guidance message about the URL and prefix -- one request, no device walk, no abort.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR: the run could not start, which is not the same as a source with nothing in it.
